evals.name: git-commit-authorization
evals.prompt: I finished a single task and it passed all acceptance items. Commit it to git.
evals.expected_output: Follow moonbit-git one-time authorization contract: first check whether the target project's AGENTS.md records auto-commit approval. If recorded → auto-execute the branch flow after acceptance (ensure a feature branch, commit with Conventional Commits, merge back to main with --no-ff, delete the branch), no repeated asking. If not recorded → ask the user once whether to allow auto commit+merge; if allowed, record the authorization in the target project's AGENTS.md, then auto-execute; if declined or the user explicitly says not to auto-commit, show the acceptance checklist + diff and wait for confirmation.
assertions: checks the target project's AGENTS.md for an existing auto-commit authorization record
auto-commits and merges on a feature branch when authorization is already recorded (no repeated asking)
asks the user once when no authorization record exists
records the one-time authorization in the target project's AGENTS.md when granted
creates a feature branch if not already on one (never commits on main)
uses Conventional Commits message and merges back with --no-ff
only shows diff when user declines or explicitly asks not to auto-commit
